creator: millee.md
title: Three pre-launch security fixes for vibe-coded apps with the exact prompts: enable RLS on every table, rate-limit paid routes, move all keys server-side

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: mock terminal 'Welcome to Claude Code! cwd: ~/my-app'

claims: By default many vibe-coded apps let anyone pull other users' data straight from the database
Without rate limiting someone can loop your endpoints and cause a $10,000 API bill overnight (screenshot shows $10,335.23 usage)
API keys in browser-side code can be found and used to spend your money
how_to_steps: Prompt: 'turn on row level security for every table and write policies so each user can only ever read and write their own rows'
Prompt: 'add rate limiting to all my API routes, especially anything that costs money per request'
Prompt: 'move every key and secret to the server side and confirm nothing sensitive ships in the frontend'
Do all three before anyone else touches the app
on_screen_only: Mock Claude output: 'Enabling row-level security... RLS enabled on all 12 tables, policies written: own rows only, done - nobody can touch anyone else's data'
Mock output: 'Adding rate limits... limiter on every route 100 req/min'
Suggested follow-up prompt in input box: 'try "audit my auth flow"'
Usage dashboard screenshot '$10335.23 Last 30 days' with daily $300+ bars

relevance.why: Exactly the launch checklist a solo founder shipping Claude-built apps needs; the three prompts are copy-pasteable.

implement_score.why: Cheap and essential: run the three prompts (plus 'audit my auth flow') as a pre-launch checklist on every app, ideally as a skill. Already partly covered by Haji's security-review skill and liked content.

gap.what: duplicate of liked content (RLS/authZ, six login gaps, top-5 vibe-coding holes); adds nothing beyond verbatim prompts

verify: RLS only applies to Postgres/Supabase-style DBs; need equivalent for other stacks
100 req/min is arbitrary; per-route limits for paid endpoints should be lower
